package rulefixtures

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"io"
	"net/http"
)

// scenario for read_then_decode_duplicate_materialization: io.ReadAll(...) materializes a payload and the same binding is then unmarshaled again instead of using a streaming decode path.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: hot_path; severity: info.
type Rule359PositiveRecord struct {
	ID     int      `json:"id"`
	Name   string   `json:"name"`
	Values []string `json:"values"`
}

func scenario359Positive(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	data, err := io.ReadAll(r.Body)
	if err != nil {
		http.Error(w, "read failed", http.StatusInternalServerError)
		return
	}
	var record Rule359PositiveRecord
	if err := json.Unmarshal(data, &record); err != nil {
		http.Error(w, "invalid json", http.StatusBadRequest)
		return
	}
	w.WriteHeader(http.StatusOK)
}
